# Meshack Mogire — Strategic Engineering & Systems Architecture
> High-performance digital infrastructure, private AI systems, and refined developer experience.

## Summary
Meshack Mogire is a Principal Systems Architect and AI Builder based in Nairobi, Kenya. He specializes in building resilient, owner-controlled digital ecosystems and private AI infrastructure. He operates a selective partnership model (limited to 5 clients) and publishes technical insights on architecture and operational efficiency.
